Require source support for a number's role as a count/measurement and any units; retain the existing ban on newly calculated results.
hypotheses: Publication wrappers will stop producing standalone subjects while discussed entities and attribution relationships remain available.
The fee-priority values will retain their supported associations without turning into invented item counts.

test: All 28 fixed development notes; inspect every output and coverage. Run fixed repeats only if the first-pass evidence warrants them.
